newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Electrolux boss doesn't exclude Raytheon unit buy.
newsitem.headline: Electrolux boss doesn't exclude Raytheon unit buy.

text.p: Electrolux chief executive Michael Treschow was quoted on Monday as saying it was possible the Swedish company might bid for the white goods division of U.S. company Raytheon.
Treschow told the Dagens Nyheter daily however that a bid was not definite. "It's a possiblity but far from a given," he said.
"Although our position of number three on the U.S. market is too weak, profitability is not just about size. Image is also important." he added.
Electrolux's main white goods product in the U.S. is Frigidaire.
The company recently announced a savings programme which includes plant closures and staff cuts of 12,000.
The company needs to boost its profits in the United States more quickly, Dagens Nyheter quoted Treschow as saying.

"Of course it is urgent to improve profits further. The planned savings programme also affects U.S. plants to improve their ability to compete even if the economy weakens again," he told the newspaper.
